parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of times the operation will be retried (not including the initial try).

initialSleepMillis.description: Sleep time for first retry (plus randomization). If <= 0 the default will be used.

exponent.description:
The exponent to multiply the prior wait time in generating the next. This should be > 1.0 and probably less than
3.0. Note that 2.0 will double the maximum possible wait each time. If <= 1 the default will be used.

maxSleepMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for each retry. If <= 0 the default will be used.

maxTotalMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for all retry waits

minSleepMillis.description: The minimum sleep time guaranteed each iteration.

retryOnEmptyResult.description: If set to true, it will retry when result is empty.

jitter.description: Determines the algorithm used to calculate jitter. See {@link ExponentialBackoff.Jitter}.

retryAllErrors.description:
If true, all errors will be retried. If false, only retryable errors {@link Retry#shouldRetryLogic}
will be retried.

trace.description:
If true, the retry logic will report each retry attempt in root `C3.action()`'s `#customContext` with key as
`retry-trace`.

enabled.description: @return `true` if this file system is enabled.

readOnlyMounts.description: List of mounts that are read only.

aclEnabledMounts.description:
List of mounts that are ACL enabled. For mounts that are ACL enabled access control is performed by
{@link FileMeta}.
